title: Kissed Portuguese Cabbage Salad
description: A fresh savoy cabbage salad with a citrusy vinaigrette, topped with creamy feta and a hint of honey for a sweet finish, perfect for a romantic date night.
instructions: Wash and finely chop the savoy cabbage into bite‑sized pieces.
In a small bowl whisk together the olive oil, balsamic vinegar, lemon zest, minced garlic, salt, and pepper until emulsified.
Pour the vinaigrette over the cabbage and toss to coat evenly.
Add the crumbled feta cheese and drizzle with honey, then gently fold all ingredients together.
Let the salad sit for 5 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, adding more salt, pepper, or honey.
Serve immediately on a chilled plate, pairing with crusty bread or grilled fish.
Enjoy the bright, grassy flavors as a light yet satisfying dinner.
